title: Improve the way you name/rename a hostpot
line: With a long login name, the default hotspot name is now shortened to fit Wi-Fi's 32-byte limit, so turning on the hotspot no longer fails.
explanation: Configuration::hotspotName() defaults to the login name plus "-hotspot" with no length check. An SSID may be at most 32 bytes, so with a login name of 25 bytes or more NetworkManager rejects the connection ("802-11-wireless.ssid: SSID length is out of range <1-32> bytes") and the Hotspot button fails, as in the report. The change chops characters off the login name until the whole default name fits in 32 UTF-8 bytes; a name the user set in the configuration is left untouched.

commits.message:
libs/editor: keep the default hotspot name within 32 bytes

The default hotspot name is the login name followed by "-hotspot", so with
a long login name it went over the 32 bytes allowed for an SSID and turning
on the hotspot failed. Now the login name is shortened until it fits.

BUG: 527192

media.caption: Wi-Fi KCM > Configure with login name beedell.roke_julian_lockhart (the reporter's): default hotspot name beedell.roke_julian_lockhart-hotspot is 37 bytes
Same with the fix: beedell.roke_julian_lock-hotspot, exactly 32 bytes

review.text: Truncating the default loginName + "-hotspot" SSID to 32 UTF-8 bytes in Configuration::hotspotName() cleanly fixes the failure for users with long login names while leaving short and user-configured names untouched. However, the commit message uses 'BUG: 527192', which will automatically close a bug that was retitled into an open UX wishlist ('Improve the way you name/rename a hostpot') whose design discussions are intentionally not implemented here.
changes: Change 'BUG: 527192' to 'CCBUG: 527192' in the commit message so merging this fix does not prematurely close the hotspot-naming UX wishlist.

reviews.text: Truncating the default '<login>-hotspot' SSID to 32 UTF-8 bytes is the right, minimal fix in the right place (Configuration::hotspotName) for the error in the original report and what the reporter asked for in c5; saved names are untouched. But the bug is now Nate's usability wish ('Improve the way you name/rename a hotspot', prompt on first use / move into list, c3-c4), which this does not implement, yet the commit uses BUG: and would close it. The entry's own notes say the bug should stay open.
changes: Use CCBUG: 527192 instead of BUG: 527192 (or split the SSID-length bug into its own report) so the naming wish stays open
Optionally avoid chopping half a surrogate pair (e.g. chop whole code points) so a non-ASCII login name can't produce an invalid string
